en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 51 - Narrated to me Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Humran and Humran Haitham bin Waqid Jazari from Abdullah Rajani that he said: I was with Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) when Abde Salih, Imam Kadhim (a.s) entered

and Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said: Ahmad, do that. I said: May I be your ransom, his name is so and so (Musa)! He replied: On the contrary, his name is Ahmad and Muhammad. After that he said: O Abdullah, indeed the master of the affair will be arrested and imprisoned for a long time. Thus when they decide to eliminate him, he would pray to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime to release him from their clutches.
